scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green 'npm run dev -w @sam/api' 'npm run dev -w @sam/web'
scripts.build: npm run build -w @sam/web && npm run build -w @sam/api
scripts.test: npm run test -w @sam/api && node --import tsx --test apps/web/src/scanning/core.test.ts
scripts.format: prettier --write apps/api/src apps/web/src apps/web/vite.config.ts apps/web/vercel.json apps/api/vercel.json apps/web/index.html apps/api/tsconfig.json apps/web/tsconfig.json apps/api/package.json apps/web/package.json tests package.json .prettierrc.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check apps/api/src apps/web/src apps/web/vite.config.ts apps/web/vercel.json apps/api/vercel.json apps/web/index.html apps/api/tsconfig.json apps/web/tsconfig.json apps/api/package.json apps/web/package.json tests package.json .prettierrc.json
